title: Rav Natan bar Minyumi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.21b.13), Rav Kahana says that Rav Natan bar Minyumi expounded in Rabbi Tanchum’s name: a Chanukah lamp placed above twenty cubits is invalid. He likewise expounds in his name there, “[The pit was empty](https://www.sefaria.org/Genesis.37.24)”—but it contained snakes and scorpions. Hyman cites Dikdukei Soferim for the reading in the Rosh that he taught in Rav’s name.

notes.text: The Rosh’s reported reading names Rav instead of Tanchum. The pit quotation is a partial quotation, as in the supplied notice.

The Gemara opens the first report at the end of 21b. The lamp ruling and the pit interpretation are both on the [next page](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.22a.1). The [Rosh’s text](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Shabbat.2.5.2) reads Rav Huna for Rav Kahana and prints Tanchum in brackets after Rav. The reading without Tanchum is Hyman’s report from Dikdukei Soferim. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2738&lang=en) likewise records the two teachings in Tanchum’s name.
